parsed.rationale: Sinus rhythm with very high precordial voltage (deep S in V1-V2 and tall R in V4-V6, summing to well over 35 mm) and no regional ST elevation meeting STEMI criteria. The ST segments are essentially isoelectric, with only the normal early-repolarisation-type ST/T morphology in V2-V4 that comes with high voltage.
